items.text: Tommy Hanson runs a commercial real estate firm. He previously worked in media at the Chicago Tribune and U.S. News & World Report. Hanson describes himself as fiscally conservative and socially liberal.

sentences.text: Tommy Hanson runs a commercial real estate firm.
He previously worked in media at the Chicago Tribune and U.S. News & World Report.
Hanson describes himself as fiscally conservative and socially liberal.

items.text: He has said no one believes U.S. elections are secure or fair. Hanson proposes requiring government-issued photo IDs and paper ballots at polling places. He also wants to limit early voting and void all ballots not counted by midnight on Election Day. He supports abolishing the federal income tax and considers tariffs a good thing. He would ask every member of Congress to sign a pledge to reduce the deficit and pay down debt or resign. He says the U.S. should do more to physically secure the southern border. In a 2024 questionnaire, he called for ending sanctuary city and state policies and ensuring immigrants come legally without handouts or free housing.

items.text: He supports eliminating the U.S. Department of Education. He also backs school choice, including voucher programs, charter schools and private schools. In a 2024 questionnaire, he said abortion access is a state decision. He opposes taxpayer funding for abortion providers. In 2024, he opposed providing U.S. money or military supplies to Ukraine and Israel. He supports full funding for law enforcement.
